hypotheses.statement: The music-only pass with Completed Harmony/TOL withheld is a scoped experimental control, not permanent deletion of bridge resources.
Later explicit Completed Harmony bridge use applies at its declared comparison level while preserving native Western and Chinese musical carriers.
Bridge absence in a different later result establishes a loss/miscarry only when the relevant experimental conditions match; mere absence otherwise leaves status unknown.
